subject: Application: Concrete Panel Detailer / Draftsperson, Marc Masarate
email_body:
Hello,

I saw your Concrete Panel Detailer / Draftsperson advert on SEEK and would like to be considered.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD. From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a field engineer and project-in-charge, where I reviewed structural and architectural drawings and checked work against project requirements. I am based in Melton VIC, hold a White Card, a licence and my own transport, and have full working rights to December 2027 on a 485 visa.

Your advert says you will train people without panel detailing experience and that the role suits new graduates. I use AutoCAD in 2D and 3D, and I modelled a footing and column in 3D in AutoCAD during my course. My drafting is from study rather than paid work, and I have not used Tekla yet.

I've attached my resume and cover letter. Could we arrange a short chat about the role?

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio
fit: Concrete panel detailer or draftsperson in Melbourne's northern suburbs on industrial, commercial and residential building projects; the advert says it will train people with no panel detailing experience and suits drafting and engineering students or new graduates.

Asks for some 2D AutoCAD and/or 3D Tekla, a building industry education or work background, and the ability to visualise in 3D from 2D drawings. Marc has AutoCAD 2D/3D from his Advanced Diploma, a footing and column modelled in 3D in AutoCAD, and reviewed structural and architectural drawings on site in the Philippines.
Victoria based and commutable from Melton; the work is building structure detailing rather than civil roads and drainage, so discipline overlap is partial.
